messages.subject: Using StatET with Shiny
messages.body_plain:
I still find StatET to be easily superior to RStudio, even for Shiny apps.

Although RStudio does have some hooks to make starting Shiny apps easy, 
it is possible to develop and run Shiny apps in StatET just fine, by 
running a couple of lines of code.

The only issue I have is that, when I get an error in Shiny, I cannot 
match up the line numbers in the traceback with the line numbers in the 
editor in StatET.  So I have to use RStudio occasionally just when I 
have tricky bugs.  It is either that, or use lots of print() statements.

I do not need Shiny debugging support as such in StatET, but is there 
any way I can match up the line numbers in tracebacks to the code?

Thanks!

P.S.  It looks as if the mailing list archives are not being updated?  
This may give some people the false impression that the list is not in use.

messages.subject: Eclipse Neon constantly freezing
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I have started working with Eclipse Neon some weeks ago and after a while it started freezing incessantly. Right now it does not function for more that 2 minutes after being started up, it stops responding and has to be forcibly shut down. Over at StackOVerflow [0] a user says this is related with the StatET plug-in, and indeed the root exception registered in the .log file is issued by a WalWare class.

Over at the Eclipse forum a user suggested using GTK2 [1], but even then the freezing continues (with the associated exception).

Could anyone inform on the cause of this exception? Is it fixable in any way? Thank you,

Luís
